content.value: ArrayList stores a resizable ordered collection of object references. Import java.util.ArrayList and specify the element type. Use Integer or Double rather than primitive type parameters. size(), get(index), set(index, value), add(value), add(index, value), and remove(index) support access and updates. Valid get/set/remove indices end at size() - 1; insertion may use size().

The final list is [Alan, Linus], old is Ada, and size is 2. set replaces without changing size; indexed add and remove shift elements. ArrayList<Integer> automatically boxes and unboxes integer values.
